verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a registry and package-manager CLI that installs, lists, updates and removes SKILL.md instruction files for other coding agents; it does not run agents itself. Setting up background or scheduled autonomous automations belongs to agent runtimes, not to a skill distribution tool. Its non-interactive (CI-friendly) install mode and `skills use --agent`, which starts an agent interactively, concern installation or launching, not autonomous background automation, so they do not make this axis applicable.
